rows.en: Connected to this affair... they must be Neo Zeon forces.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The allies seem to be the refugee ships' escort. The enemy has spread out to attack it.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We will proceed straight to the <pic(0)><cs(3)>combat zone<ce()> and destroy the unidentified unit.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Our objective is to destroy the refugee fleet and stop Char's plan.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We can't afford to waste time here. We will attempt to break through.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We still can't get through to Earth. We have no choice but to stop the plan ourselves.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: From here on, we will be acting on our own judgment.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Whatever that may lead to, we must not let it come to the worst.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We must settle everything, once and for all.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Does this mean we are still not strong enough to bring about peace...?
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?
